title: Casey's Last Ride
original_lyrics:
[chorus]
The stairway to the subway and the shadows down below
Following the footsteps through the neon darkened corridor
Of silent desperation, never speaking to soul
The poison air he's breathing has dirty smell of dying

[chorus]
rain

[chorus]
Of the clicking of the turnstile and the rattle of the

[chorus]
"Oh", she said "Casey it's been so long since I've seen you"
"Here," she said "Just kiss to make body smile"
"See," she said "I've put on new stockings just to please
you"
"Lord," she said "Casey can you only stay while"

[chorus]
For something wet to wipe away the chill that's in his bones
Seeing his reflection in the lives of all the lonely men
Who reach for any thing they can to keep from going home
Standing in the corner, Casey drinks his pint of bitter
Never glancing in the mirror at the people passing by
He stumbles as he's leaving and he wonders if the reason
Is the beer that's in his bell or the tear that's in his eye
"Oh", she said "I suppose you seldom think about me"
"Now", she said, "Now that you've family of your own
"Still", she said "It's so blesses good to feel your body
"Lord", she said "Casey it's shame to be alone"
